posts.caption: Keep moving forward, even if it's messy and especially when it's perfect. Soon you will look back and see how far you've come!

ManyChat Pro would have cost me $39 a month, so I asked Claude to build my own version. Comment “TRAPS” for my free setup trap checklist. Now a keyword comment gets a DM, a READY reply gets the link, and everyone who signs up lands on my email list. YouTube comments get a reply too, and it all runs on a $6 a month server.

Claude did the technical parts. I did the account setup and the clicks, and two of those clicks could have cost me weeks.

Comment-to-DM tools can send one message per comment, and it has to go out within 7 days. Comment “AUTODM” for my free Auto-DM Rulebook. That's Meta's private reply rule, and every tool follows it, ManyChat included.

After that, you can only keep talking if they reply, which opens a 24-hour window. So make your one message ask for a reply. Mine says: reply READY and I'll send it over.

#instagramtips #smallbusinessmarketing #aiforbusiness

Comment MATH and I’ll send you the free $1K Math calculator. Where the numbers come from: Littledata’s study of 421 Shopify stores found a median of 1.4% of visits ending in a sale. For visits, link-in-bio benchmarks put taps at about 1 to 3% of profile visits, and only some viewers visit your profile, so a fraction of 1% of views is typical. That’s why a comment word that sends your link in a DM helps so much: it skips the profile visit. One more thing: Instagram counts replays as views, so views are always higher than the number of people.

If your AI keeps writing [PRICE] in your posts, it doesn't know what you sell yet. The Scrolly Business Brain gives ChatGPT and Claude one place to read your offers, prices and customers. Find it at scrollyseo.com.

Here's what changed for me: my offers, prices, who each one is for and what I'm working on all live in one central place. When I ask AI for a post, it reads that first and writes with the real details.

You still check the output. You just stop spending more time correcting AI than it would take to write the post yourself.

What does your AI get wrong most often about your business? 👇

Never get AI slop again, here's how! 👇

Do you ask AI to write something for you, only for it to come back with that slightly artificial twist? Or worse, the dreaded em dash. You know what I'm talking about 😂

As a business owner, I want everything in my marketing to meet the same standard, and that includes what AI writes. So I taught it what's acceptable: how I talk, the words I love and the phrases I'd never use.

It's a one-time setup, and it keeps learning as you go. During setup it can even look back through your past chats for things you forgot to mention.

Check out scrollyseo.com to copy my homework and build your own Scrolly Business Brain.
